{{Quote|Do you think Gravid's young apprentice was hindered by the prosthesis she was forced to wear after fighting him?|Darth Plagueis, to Darth Sidious, regarding Darth Gean|<ref name="DP" />}}
'''Darth Gean''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprenticed]] to [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Gravid]], as part of the [[Order of the Sith Lords]]. Around [[533 BBY]], Gean learned that Gravid, who attempted to blend [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] doctrines with his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings, was trying to destroy all the various [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]], tomes, and [[Sith holocron/Legends|holocrons]] that contained Sith teachings. Gean penetrated the [[Force barrier/Legends|Force shields]] that Gravid had placed around the [[Darth Gravid's bastion|bastion]] that they had built together on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]] and was able to [[Death/Legends|kill]] her [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]]. Nevertheless, during the [[Duel in Darth Gravid's bastion|fight]], Gravid grievously injured Gean, which forced her to wear [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetics]]. She eventually took an apprentice of her own, continuing the [[Rule of Two/Legends|lineage]] instituted by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], eventually becoming the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Gravid]] and taking the name [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Gean. During her tenure as Gravid's pupil, Gean helped her [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] construct a [[Darth Gravid's bastion|bastion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]]. However, Gean's Master had begun to lose his sanity, because he attempted to combine [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] philosophies, such as benevolence and empathy, into his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings.<ref name="DP" />

At some point around [[533 BBY]],<ref name="Note">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}} establishes that [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was born 46 years before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[46 BBY/Legends|46 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] (25: The Discreet Charm of the Meritocracy) states that Padmé Amidala "has only just turned thirteen" and that Gravid's reign "elapsed some five [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] earlier" which would place the quote regarding Gravid's death in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. Thus, this article assumes that Gean [[Death/Legends|killed]] Gravid around [[533 BBY]].</ref> Gravid&mdash;who had concluded that his repository of [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]] and tomes needed to be destroyed so that he could rebuild the organization&mdash;used the Force to raise [[Force barrier/Legends|barriers]] around his bastion and began eradicating the Sith knowledge in his possession. Gean broke through the shields around their stronghold and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|confronted]] her Master in a [[Duel in Darth Gravid's bastion|duel]]. During the fight, Gean was gravely injured after Gravid cleaved off one of her [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and shoulders as well as the left side of the Twi'lek's face and chest. However, Gean gained the upper hand, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Gravid despite being unarmed.<ref name="DP" />

After the confrontation, Gean acquired [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetics]] to replace the limbs she had lost. She eventually took an apprentice of her own and continued with the [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]]&mdash;which was instituted by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], the founder of the [[Order of the Sith Lords]]&mdash;to topple the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In taking her apprentice, Gean continued the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], an ordinance also instituted by Bane that restricted the Sith to a single Master and apprentice. [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], recounted her actions to his apprentice, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], believing her to be courageous.<ref name="DP" />

==Personality and traits==
After discovering Darth Gravid's plan to destroy the Sith teachings, Darth Gean displayed complete dedication to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and the Sith Order by fighting and murdering her Master, despite being seriously injured in their duel.<ref name="DP" />

==Powers and abilities==
Darth Gean was sensitive to the Force and was powerful enough to break through her Master's Force barriers around his fortress. She was also able to survive the confrontation with Gravid, despite being grievously injured and being forced to wear prosthetics as a result. According to Darth Plagueis, the Twi'lek's [[Force power/Legends|power]] with the Force was not obstructed on account of her cybernetics.<ref name="DP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Gean was introduced in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]]. Her character was created to explain some of the background of the Order of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]].
